newsitem.title: USA: Capsure sees CNA merger complete in second quarter.
newsitem.headline: Capsure sees CNA merger complete in second quarter.

text.p: Capsure Holdings Corp said Thursday that it expects its previously announced merger with CNA Financial Corp will be finalized in the second quarter.
In December 1996, CNA and Capsure said they agreed to form a new stock company, CNA Surety Corp., which will be the largest surety company in the United States.

"We have made submissions to each of the requisite governmental and regulatory authorities that must approve this transaction," Bruce Esselborn, chairman, said in a statement. "We have obtained antitrust clearance from the Federal Trade Commission and all other filings are at various stages of the regulatory review process."
Earlier, Capsure reported first quarter operating earnings from continuing operations of $0.23 a share, up from $0.17 a year ago.
Gross and net written premiums at the company's surety unit rose four percent to $26.7 million and at its fidelity unit rose five percent to $25.6 million.
